description: Remove one entry from the allowlist by its entry id, which comes from mba_list_allowlist_entries (it is not the phone number). Returns no content on success. While ai_audience is ALLOWLISTED_ONLY, removing the entry stops the agent answering that consumer.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

entry_id.description: Allowlist entry id, as returned by list_allowlist_entries.

name: mba_remove_allowlist_entry
title: Remove an allowlisted number
